insight: Founded in 2020 by George Sivulka, who left a Stanford PhD; raised a $130M a16z-led Series B in 2024 while already profitable.
name: Hebbia
tagline: Enterprise AI that analyzes vast document sets for finance and law.
description: Hebbia is an enterprise AI platform that lets analysts ask complex, multi-step questions across huge libraries of filings, transcripts, and internal documents. Its Matrix interface returns answers in a spreadsheet-style grid, with each cell traceable back to its source. It is used heavily across investment banking, private equity, and legal research.

modelSupport.notes: Decomposes questions across documents using frontier models via its agent framework.

changelog.summary: Recategorized from research-platform to the new finance category (enterprise finance research).

edge: Matrix answers each query as a traceable spreadsheet grid via an agent swarm over millions of docs, not one RAG pass.
cons: Answers a fixed doc set, takes no actions
